findings.message: Before updating the stx_mnt_id field, according to statx system call definition (https://www.man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/statx.2.html), we need to check whether the STATX_MNT_ID bit is set in stx_mask to make sure that this field is required by caller.
findings.tp_fp_justification: TinaZhangZW flags the new stx_mnt_id population: the returned stx_mask does not declare STATX_MNT_ID, so userspace cannot know the field is valid (statx contract: only fields advertised in the returned mask may be relied on). Author accepts and adds STATX_MNT_ID to stx_mask in response (2555404885). Introduced by this PR (stx_mnt_id was previously hardcoded 0). Confirmed at exam_head: stx_mask (L137-148) omits STATX_MNT_ID while stx_mnt_id is populated at L172.
